character_system_text.1091:10000: I knew I could go across the sea with you♪ Take me anywhere in the whole wide world, okay?♡
character_system_text.1091:10001: There are some clothes I wanna go see, but Mama has work... Ehe, will you come with me?
character_system_text.1091:10002: Tore-cchi, your bag got fixed up so nicely! Let's make new memories with the new strap too♪
character_system_text.1091:10003: Happy New Year! My family's going to a fancy Japanese restaurant again this year. I'm gonna enjoy the classy vibes♪
character_system_text.1091:10004: I traded chocolates with Onee-chan♪ I'm still looking for Chevacchi! Tell me if you find her!
character_system_text.1091:10005: Chocolate, pleeease♡ Ehe, I knew it♪ I just knew you'd have some ready for me, Tore-cchi!
character_system_text.1091:10006: I'm curious about the night safari in Dubai too♪ Being surrounded by a sky full of stars is super romantic, right?
character_system_text.1091:10007: Trick or treat☆ You're a nice Tore-cchi, so you know which one to pick, riiight?
character_system_text.1091:10008: I wanna see Christmas lights♪ The glamorous, gorgeous kind! Hey, wanna go right now?
character_system_text.1091:10009: Do you have a tree in your room, Tore-cchi? Want me to decorate it? I'm confident I can make it super sparkly☆
character_system_text.1091:10010: We made so many memories this year♪ Oh, I know, wanna quiz each other on how much we remember?
character_system_text.1091:10011: Happy birthday, Tore-cchi! Today I'll be the onee-chan♪ "Now then, what is it you desire?"
character_system_text.1091:10012: Wanna go shopping? Or chat more? Today we'll do everything you wanna do, Tore-cchi!
character_system_text.1091:10013: I loooove my birthday! It's the day everyone makes me the happiest girl in the whole world!
character_system_text.1091:10014: I'm happy with anything you give me, Tore-cchi♪ 'Cause it means you were thinking of me♡
character_system_text.1091:10015: There's a notice. Be sure to check it♪
character_system_text.1091:10016: You've got a present! Hey, can I open it?
character_system_text.1091:10017: Mission clear! You worked so hard, Tore-cchi♪ Good job, good jooob!
character_system_text.1091:10018: An event's coming up soon! I wonder if there's a glamorous reward or something?
character_system_text.1091:10019: There's an event going on! Let's go together! Hurry, hurry♪
character_system_text.1091:10025: Ribbons, frills, hearts... They're all super cute and I love them♡ Which one do you like, Tore-cchi?
character_system_text.1091:10026: I go shopping with Onee-chan a lot. She has great taste and picks out the stuff that looks best on me♪
character_system_text.1091:10027: I wanna get matching rings with Chevacchi too. Maybe she'd wear them if they were simple?
character_system_text.1091:20000: I'm not feeeeling it... No no, today's a day off!
character_system_text.1091:20001: Pushing yourself when you're worn out is bad. Riiight?
character_system_text.1091:20002: Let's train, let's train! I'll show you how I'm better than yesterday♪
character_system_text.1091:20003: Getting stronger and stronger, and then GO☆ to Dubai!
character_system_text.1091:20004: Anything goes! Taking requests with a big bonus right now♪
character_system_text.1091:20005: I'm full of energy! Maybe 'cause I ate lots like you told me, Tore-cchi?
character_system_text.1091:20006: I wonder how you'll praise me later? I'm looking forward to it.
character_system_text.1091:20007: I want you to make my good points grow more and more♪
character_system_text.1091:20008: I'd like today to be not too tiring... No good?
character_system_text.1091:20009: Let me rest a little longer... Just a liiittle longer...
character_system_text.1091:20010: Hmm... I might not be able to try that hard right now...
character_system_text.1091:20011: I know I have to, but... Does it have to be now?
character_system_text.1091:20021: If you'll do everything I ask, maybe I'll run... Hmmm...
character_system_text.1091:20022: Ugh, I can't race anymore... I'm so tired... I'm all wobbly...
character_system_text.1091:20023: I'm super fast today! Don't you dare miss it♪
character_system_text.1091:20024: My condition is the best! All I need now is you cheering me on, Tore-cchi, and it's perfect!
character_system_text.1091:20025: Going full sparkle mode☆ Celebrity, here I come!
character_system_text.1091:20026: I feel like I can zoom to a win☆ Off I go with tons of energy!
character_system_text.1091:20027: I'm gonna show off everything we worked for together, Tore-cchi!
character_system_text.1091:20028: If I win, I might get even more fans! Eek, what'll I do♪
character_system_text.1091:20029: My first step toward being a celebrity! I'll do my best today too.
character_system_text.1091:20030: I'm looking good today too, right☆ If people are gonna watch, I wanna look cute.
character_system_text.1091:20031: Don't worry, I'll be fine. Racing's my thing.
character_system_text.1091:20032: I'm feeling kinda so-so... Mm, but I'm okay. 'Cause you're watching me, Tore-cchi.
character_system_text.1091:20033: Can you repeat after me? "Viv-chan, you're so cute♡" ...Yeah, I feel a little better.
character_system_text.1091:20034: You can't be a celebrity if you're not sparkly. Smile, smile.
character_system_text.1091:20035: I'll be okay... right? 'Cause I worked hard with you, Tore-cchi...?
character_system_text.1091:20036: ...Will you praise me after the race? Then I think I can try a little harder...
character_system_text.1091:20037: I'm definitely gonna win the race... If I lose, I can't become a celebrity...
character_system_text.1091:20049: We made so many wonderful memories♪
character_system_text.1091:30001: Hmm, I could've tried a little harder!
character_system_text.1091:60001: Watch closely♪ I'm gonna stand out the most!
character_system_text.1091:70001: Right after I met you, I thought♪ You're kinder and more wonderful than anyone else♡ ...I mean it!
character_system_text.1091:90000: Morning, Tore-cchi♪ Let's make today another super sparkly, heart-fluttering day!
character_system_text.1091:90001: Onee-chan told me smoothies alone aren't enough. I'm eating a proper breakfast, I promise.
character_system_text.1091:90002: How are you, Tore-cchi? Me? I'm super great 'cause I got to see you♪
character_system_text.1091:90003: Let's train after we have some tea, okay? I don't want the fun time to end yet!
character_system_text.1091:90004: Thanks for your hard work. You did it for my races, right? Ehe, that makes me happy♪
character_system_text.1091:90005: Mmm... I'm getting sleepy... Hey, Tore-cchi... Walk me back to the dorm...?
character_system_text.1091:90006: It's the season for new clothes, makeup, and bags! I can't decide what to check out first♪
character_system_text.1091:90007: I'm going to a night pool with Mama soon. What should I do, which swimsuit should I bring? Kyaa♡
character_system_text.1091:90008: They say you can see amazing art in Dubai too. Perfect for autumn, the season of art, right?
character_system_text.1091:90009: I bought some wintery makeup! I might transform into a cool beauty? Look forward to it♡
character_system_text.1091:91000: If you wanna hear the latest trends, it's gotta be Crown! She knows tons of celebrity news, it's amazing.
character_system_text.1091:91001: Hong Kong is nice too. Lots of tall buildings, and the night view is so pretty! I wanna make a toast up in a tower♪
character_system_text.1091:91002: We're talking about having a girls' party in Satono's limo. What snacks should I bring?
character_system_text.1091:91003: Checking celebrity news today too☆ Mmm♪ Hollywood actors' love lives are so flashy and thrilling!
character_system_text.1091:91004: Earth always praises me, but sometimes her eyes get really serious... and it's kinda... Kyaa!
character_system_text.1091:91005: I'm good at dancing. I have to be ready to dance whenever I get invited to a glamorous party♪
character_system_text.1091:91006: I want lots of applause at the live☆ I'll secretly wink just at you, Tore-cchi♡
character_system_text.1091:91007: Imagine it! A blue cape fluttering by a beach overseas! Isn't that super emo?
character_system_text.1091:91008: Wanna go on a cruise right now? With this look, I'd fit right in on any sea, right♪
character_system_text.1091:91009: Morning baths are so nice. You get to start the day with smooth skin♪
character_system_text.1091:91010: When I'm in serious mode, I ask Duramente about lunch. She knows tons about nutrition and is super reliable♪
character_system_text.1091:91011: Eek!! Did something just make a noise?! ...Th-the wind...? Really...?
character_system_text.1091:91012: ...Hey, take a sniff! Smells like flowers, right? I tried a springy perfume♪
character_system_text.1091:91013: It's the season of pretty seas! Which means it's the season for fishing with Chevacchi! Alright, I'm gonna go invite her!
character_system_text.1091:91014: It's getting dry lately. I have to take care of my skin to keep it smooth.
character_system_text.1091:91015: Hm? I'm not cold. I've always been fine with it. Were you maybe thinking of ways to warm me up?
character_system_text.1091:92000: I'm the type who grows when praised! So help me grow lots♪
character_system_text.1091:92001: You came up with a menu just for me, right? Tell me, tell me!
character_system_text.1091:92002: Growing more and more☆ Don't take your eyes off me.
character_system_text.1091:92003: Onee-chan and the others must be working hard too. I won't lose!
character_system_text.1091:92011: Blue sea, white sand! I loooove scenery that feels like a resort like this♪
character_system_text.1091:92005: I wonder what today's reward will be. Something fun? Something tasty? I'm expecting a lot, so I'm counting on you♪
character_system_text.1091:92006: Hey hey, do you have plans after training? There are some clothes I wanna see. Please, I wanna go with you, Tore-cchi!
character_system_text.1091:92007: What should we do when we go to Dubai? Racing, of course, but I wanna enjoy our private time too♡
character_system_text.1091:93000: Amazing, right? I got this sparkly☆
character_system_text.1091:93001: And a gold star for you too, Tore-cchi, for working so hard!
character_system_text.1091:95000: I'm gonna get even more amazing!
character_system_text.1091:95004: To become a sparkly celebrity! Let your heart flutter with me♪
character_system_text.1091:40001: Hmhmm♪ This! That! I want it all! I'm not gonna stop at just dreaming about it!
character_system_text.1091:30004: I'm gonna be a celebrity! Of course I won!
character_system_text.1091:30005: Eek, I got closer to being a celebrity♪
character_system_text.1091:110000: What are we doing? If it's something fun, maybe I'll join♪
character_system_text.1091:110001: We made lots of memories. What was the most fun?
character_system_text.1091:110002: A race? Sure! You'll give me a reward too, right?
character_system_text.1091:10021: Your Umamusume Directory leveled up! Good job, Tore-cchi!
character_system_text.1091:95005: I'll help you out even more♪
character_system_text.1091:95006: I can even do stuff like this♪
character_system_text.1091:70004: The big ribbon and the fluttery frills are super cute, they're my favorite♪
character_system_text.1091:70010: My outfit is on point today too! The colors and shape suit me perfectly, right?
character_system_text.1091:70008: Nice sparkly vibes, right? The poofy hem is a big plus too♪
character_system_text.1091:70014: Everyone's super cute too, but on stage I want you to only watch me.
character_system_text.1091:70009: Well, well? This fluttery cuteness! There's only one thing to say, right?

character_system_text.1091:2033: If I win, I might get even more fans! Eek, what'll I do♪
character_system_text.1091:2034: Going full sparkle mode☆ Celebrity, here I come!
character_system_text.1091:90010: Good mooorning! What percent sparkle mode are you today, Tore-cchi? Me? 120 percent☆
character_system_text.1091:90011: When I wear my hair down, I use extra hair oil. It's all nice and neat, right?
character_system_text.1091:90012: Today's tea time is a mango frappé for a tropical vibe♪ Want the same, Tore-cchi?
character_system_text.1091:90013: Hi, handsome! Just kidding♪ I'm studying lots of English so I can live a glamorous life overseas someday☆
character_system_text.1091:90113: Hi, gorgeous! Just kidding♪ I'm studying lots of English so I can live a glamorous life overseas someday☆
character_system_text.1091:90014: What aroma should I use for bedtime tonight? I'll ask Messiah when I get back!
character_system_text.1091:90015: I'm hooked on foreign dramas lately! Where a dangerous romance goes is so dramatic... It's sooo thrilling☆
character_system_text.1091:90016: To match the floral print, all my fragrances are floral♪ Even more glamorous than usual, right?
character_system_text.1091:90017: Gotta protect my hair from the sun too. I have to keep the cuticles super glossy☆
character_system_text.1091:90018: Hot springs are nice this season too♪ A private cottage with an open-air bath... and maybe a personal concierge!
character_system_text.1091:90019: Brrr... Hey, Tore-cchi, wanna train in the heated pool today? Cold days are when we need tropical vibes, right?
character_system_text.1091:91016: Ai knows a lot about Dubai! She says she studies the geography, manners, and language there. I'm gonna learn from her!
character_system_text.1091:91017: Onee-chan taught me how to curl my hair☆ The most important point is not burning yourself on the iron!
character_system_text.1091:91018: If I go on vacation, I'll need a dress for dinner... and I wanna get pumps, accessories, and a bag too!
character_system_text.1091:91019: When we're full after eating out, Chevacchi is super reliable! She's like, "Leave it to me"!
character_system_text.1091:91020: Crown said to come to Satono Resort again♪ Next time I'll invite Onee-chan too!
character_system_text.1091:91028: I like blue, but pink is super cute too. It makes my heart flutter with excitement☆
character_system_text.1091:91029: When I said I wanted matching nails, she said only on our toes♪ ...Ehehe, that's so Chevacchi.
character_system_text.1091:91021: I dreamed I traveled first class today♪ Someday I'm definitely gonna make it real!
character_system_text.1091:91022: Maybe I should think of poses for my next interview. Hey Tore-cchi, could you take some photos?
character_system_text.1091:91023: Talking to Mama on the phone made me miss her... Ugh, if I had a private jet I could go right away!
character_system_text.1091:91024: It's so warm, perfect date weather♪ Wanna go have lunch with a view from the top floor of a tower?
character_system_text.1091:91025: I'm bringing this swimsuit to summer camp too! Let's enjoy beach walks and sea café hopping together☆
character_system_text.1091:91026: In autumn my family often goes on drives to see the leaves. Papa looks super cool driving♪
character_system_text.1091:91027: Winter resorts are nice too! Having tea in the lounge while watching the snow is the best, right?
character_system_text.1091:92015: All set! I put on plenty of sunscreen too♪
character_system_text.1091:92016: To enjoy a glamorous vacation, I have to work hard now, right!
character_system_text.1091:92017: I wanna have as much fun as I can with training too☆
character_system_text.1091:92018: Onee-chan said training your mental strength is important too, but... ugh, I don't want iron ball training...
character_system_text.1091:92020: Hey hey, let's make plans for after training! A meal today? Shopping? What should we do♪
character_system_text.1091:92021: There are still so many places I wanna go with you, Tore-cchi! You'll go to all of them with me, right?
character_system_text.1091:92022: What kind of fashion do you like, Tore-cchi? If you want, I could pick out a suit that would look good on you!
character_system_text.1091:92122: What kind of fashion do you like, Tore-cchi? If you want, I could pick out a dress that would look good on you!
character_system_text.1091:93004: We got to enjoy the best vacation together♪
character_system_text.1091:93005: It was so fun, the trip went by in a flash☆
character_system_text.1091:95010: It's Vivlos! Let's go with resort vibes♪
character_system_text.1091:70017: Lots of frills get me so hyped!
character_system_text.1091:71017: Lots of frills get me so hyped!
character_system_text.1091:95009: Transforming into a dazzling, sparkly me☆ Let's enjoy our vacation together♪
character_system_text.1091:40004: Over here☆ Wait, whoa?! I wanna ride that! I wanna ride it! I wanna ride it! ...Ehehe, thanks♪
character_system_text.1091:30006: Let's go straight to the resort like this☆
character_system_text.1091:30007: Eek, I got closer to being a celebrity♪
character_system_text.1091:70019: Everything looks good on me♪ Right?
character_system_text.1091:71019: Everything looks good on me♪ Right?
character_system_text.1091:81000: Wanna race? Sure! I'll see just how sparkly you are♪
character_system_text.1091:81001: Wow! That's pretty amazing...! But I can still make hearts flutter more than you♪
character_system_text.1091:400001: A festival all night with everyone? There's no way that's not fun! Let's enjoy it together, Chevacchi♪
character_system_text.1091:400005: The muse is definitely Onee-chan! 'Cause she's the prettiest, strongest, and coolest♡
character_system_text.1091:400011: Next, I'm getting a racing outfit too♪ So I can match with Onee-chan, I'm never giving up!
character_system_text.1091:400008: "I bought a new swimsuit, so let's go to the pool together☆" ...Sent. I wonder if Onee-chan will compliment my swimsuit?
character_system_text.1091:400114: Crown, let's stay one more night♪ I forgot to eat the limited parfait☆ Pretty please? Pleeease!
character_system_text.1091:400012: Here's the event mission☆ Aim to be a true celebrity!
character_system_text.1091:400013: Looks like there are more rewards! I wonder what? Sweets? Let's hurry and get them☆
character_system_text.1091:70020: I really do love blue. It's the same color as Onee-chan and Chevacchi!
character_system_text.1091:70021: Celebrities need a bit of sexiness too, right? Showing a little tummy? Kyaa♡
